body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2026-05-18 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "we are targeting an overall reduction of almost INR1,000 crores in the debt ... INR500 crores should happen by end of Q2 and another INR500 crores by the end of the year" Metric: Net debt incl. acceptances. Target: <= ~INR 6,222 cr at Sep-26. Deadline: 2026-09-30. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Sep-26 INR 7,793 cr: up INR 1,071 cr instead of down 500. Screener borrowings 5,378 -> 6,305. Explanation given: INR 600 cr collections (incl. Afghanistan, client advances) landed in October; INR 160 cr strategic inventory; water/metro collections short (Nov-26 opening)
